description_en: Queries the custom HTTP flood protection (CC protection) rules for website traffic
description_zh: 查询网站业务频率控制防护（CC防护）的自定义规则
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-cc-rules-v2 --domain example.com --page-size 20 --offset 0 --owner manual --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWebCCRulesV2

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the website protected by Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium
parameters.help_zh: 要接入DDoS高防进行防护的网站域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **20**. Default value: **20**
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，即每页显示多少个结果。最大值**20**，默认值**20**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The starting index of the results to return. Default value: **0**

parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en:
